combustion_rules.description: Planetary combustion (Asta) occurs when a planet comes too close to the Sun, causing it to lose its strength and become unable to deliver its full results. The Sun's intense rays overpower the planet's significations.

general_principles.definition: A planet is combust when it is within specific degrees of the Sun, measured by celestial longitude
general_principles.measurement: Distance is measured in absolute degrees between Sun and planet
general_principles.direction: Combustion applies whether planet is ahead or behind the Sun
general_principles.sun_immune: The Sun cannot be combust. Moon's nodes (Rahu/Ketu) are also not subject to combustion
general_principles.strength_loss: Combust planets lose 50-75% of their natural strength
general_principles.deep_combustion: When a planet is within deep combustion degrees, effects are more severe (75-90% strength loss)
general_principles.visibility: Combustion relates to the planet's inability to be seen when too close to the Sun
general_principles.recovery: Planet recovers strength gradually as it moves away from combustion degree

effects.general: Mental confusion, emotional instability, weakened intuition, mother's health concerns, disturbance in domestic peace, difficulty in connecting with emotions
effects.positive_blocked: Reduced emotional intelligence, diminished nurturing ability, weakened popularity, loss of public connection, impaired memory
effects.negative_amplified: Anxiety, depression, mood swings, insomnia, digestive issues, strained maternal relationships, difficulty with women in general

remedies: Wear pearl (minimum 5 carats) in silver on Monday during waxing moon
Chant 'Om Som Somaya Namah' 108 times daily
Donate white items (rice, milk, white clothes) on Mondays
Offer water to Moon on Monday evenings
Keep silver vessel with water near bed
Donate to old-age homes or single mothers
cancellation: Moon in own sign (Cancer) reduces combustion by 50%
Moon in exaltation (Taurus) reduces combustion by 40%
Aspect of Jupiter on combust Moon provides 30% protection
Moon in 4th house from Sun gets some relief through digbala
Moon in bright fortnight (Shukla Paksha) better than dark fortnight

effects.general: Reduced courage and initiative, impulsive anger, rash decisions, conflicts with siblings and authority, accidents and injuries, property disputes, surgical complications
effects.positive_blocked: Diminished leadership ability, reduced physical strength and stamina, lack of assertiveness, poor competitive spirit, weakened technical skills
effects.negative_amplified: Aggression without direction, violence, accidents especially fire/weapons, blood disorders, fevers, conflicts with brothers, property loss, litigation

remedies: Wear red coral (minimum 7 carats) in gold/copper on Tuesday
Chant 'Om Angarakaya Namah' or Hanuman Chalisa daily
Donate red items (red lentils, red clothes, jaggery) on Tuesdays
cancellation: Mars in own signs (Aries/Scorpio) reduces combustion by 50%
Mars in exaltation (Capricorn) reduces combustion by 40%
Mars in 10th house from Sun gains digbala protection
Jupiter's aspect provides 25% protection
Mars in own nakshatra (Mrigashira, Chitra, Dhanishtha) gives some relief

effects.general: Communication problems, poor decision-making, nervous disorders, business losses, educational difficulties, speech impediments, documentation errors, technology failures
effects.positive_blocked: Reduced intelligence and analytical ability, poor communication skills, diminished business acumen, learning difficulties, lack of wit and humor
effects.negative_amplified: Nervous breakdowns, anxiety, stuttering, miscommunication, fraud, forgery, business disputes, contract problems, skin diseases, respiratory issues

remedies: Wear emerald (minimum 5 carats) in gold on Wednesday
Donate green items (green moong dal, green clothes, emerald) on Wednesdays
cancellation: Mercury in own signs (Gemini/Virgo) reduces combustion by 50%
Mercury in exaltation (Virgo) reduces combustion by 40%
Mercury within 3 degrees of Sun (Budhaditya Yoga) can give brilliance in specific areas despite combustion
Venus conjunction or aspect provides 20% protection
Mercury retrograde and combust can give unique analytical abilities

effects.general: Loss of wisdom and judgment, financial losses, health issues, strained relationships with teachers and father, lack of faith, difficulty in higher learning, problems with children
effects.positive_blocked: Reduced wisdom and philosophical understanding, diminished wealth and prosperity, poor judgment, lack of optimism, weakened dharmic orientation
effects.negative_amplified: Financial disasters, liver problems, obesity or weight issues, problems with children (especially sons), loss of faith, legal troubles, issues with gurus and mentors

remedies: Wear yellow sapphire (minimum 5 carats) in gold on Thursday
Chant 'Om Gurave Namah' or Guru Gayatri 108 times daily
Donate yellow items (turmeric, yellow clothes, gold, yellow lentils) on Thursdays
Donate to educational institutions and temples
cancellation: Jupiter in own signs (Sagittarius/Pisces) reduces combustion by 50%
Jupiter in exaltation (Cancer) reduces combustion by 40%
Jupiter in angles (1,4,7,10) from Sun gets some protection
Jupiter combust but with Moon reduces negative effects by 30%
Jupiter in own nakshatra (Punarvasu, Vishakha, Purva Bhadrapada) gives relief

effects.general: Relationship problems, marital discord, loss of comforts and luxuries, artistic blocks, reproductive issues, kidney problems, difficulty with women, loss of beauty and charm
effects.positive_blocked: Reduced artistic abilities, loss of charm and attraction, diminished luxury and comfort, poor relationship skills, lack of refinement
effects.negative_amplified: Broken relationships, infidelity, divorce, sexual problems, diseases of reproductive organs, kidney stones, diabetes, problems with wife/women, artistic failures

remedies: Wear diamond or white sapphire (minimum 1 carat diamond / 5 carats white sapphire) in gold/silver on Friday
Donate white items (white clothes, rice, sugar, curd) on Fridays
Feed cows with white food items
cancellation: Venus in own signs (Taurus/Libra) reduces combustion by 50%
Venus in exaltation (Pisces) reduces combustion by 40%
Mercury conjunction provides some protection (20%)
Venus in angles from Sun (especially 7th) gets relief
Venus in own nakshatra (Bharani, Purva Phalguni, Purva Ashadha) reduces effects

effects.general: Increased delays and obstacles, chronic health issues, depression and isolation, career stagnation, problems with servants/subordinates, fears and anxieties, karmic difficulties
effects.positive_blocked: Reduced discipline and patience, lack of perseverance, poor organizational skills, diminished sense of duty, weakened detachment
effects.negative_amplified: Severe depression, chronic diseases (especially bones/joints), extreme poverty, complete isolation, career failures, accidents, falls, problems with elderly, paralysis

remedies: Wear blue sapphire (minimum 5 carats) in silver/gold on Saturday - ONLY after careful trial
Chant 'Om Shanaye Namah' or Shani Stotra 108 times daily
Donate black items (black sesame, black clothes, iron, mustard oil) on Saturdays
Serve the poor, elderly, and disabled
Light sesame oil lamp under peepal tree on Saturdays
cancellation: Saturn in own signs (Capricorn/Aquarius) reduces combustion by 50%
Saturn in exaltation (Libra) reduces combustion by 40%
Saturn in 10th from Sun gets digbala protection
Jupiter's aspect provides significant relief (35%)
Saturn in own nakshatra (Pushya, Anuradha, Uttara Bhadrapada) reduces effects
Saturn combust in dusthana (6,8,12) may give better results through enemies destruction

1.general_effects: Affects personality, physical body, self-confidence, and overall life direction. Person may lack self-esteem and struggle with identity
1.moon: Weak constitution, emotional instability, poor self-image, mother's influence diminished, mental health issues
1.mars: Lack of courage, weak body, anger issues, poor leadership, head injuries, skin problems on face
1.mercury: Poor communication, nervous disposition, skin problems, lack of intelligence expression, speech impediments
1.jupiter: Lack of wisdom in personal conduct, weight issues, poor judgment, loss of optimism, weak constitution
1.venus: Loss of charm and beauty, relationship issues affecting identity, lack of comfort in own skin, facial problems
1.saturn: Chronic health issues, depression, pessimism, delays in life, dark complexion, weak bones

2.general_effects: Affects wealth, family, speech, food, face/eyes, and accumulated resources. Financial instability and family conflicts common
2.moon: Family unhappiness, poor eating habits, eye problems, weak memory, speech lacks emotion, reduced savings
2.mars: Harsh speech, family conflicts, blood-related facial issues, accident to face/eyes, losses through siblings
2.mercury: Poor business acumen, losses in trade, stammering, poor education foundation, disputes over money
2.jupiter: Financial losses, lack of family values, poor diet leading to health issues, loss of ancestral wealth
2.venus: Losses through women, poor family relationships with spouse, lack of savings, problems with right eye
2.saturn: Poverty, miserly nature, dental problems, harsh speech, chronic family problems, difficulties accumulating wealth

3.general_effects: Affects siblings, courage, communication, short travels, skills, and efforts. Problems with younger siblings and lack of initiative
3.moon: Weak mind affecting efforts, problems with younger sister, poor short-term memory, lack of emotional courage
3.mars: Excessive but misdirected courage, conflicts with brothers, accident-prone during travels, sports injuries
3.mercury: Poor writing skills, communication breakdowns, losses in business ventures, problems with co-borns
3.jupiter: Lack of wisdom in efforts, poor relationship with younger siblings, unsuccessful short journeys
3.venus: Artistic skills blocked, poor relationships with younger sisters, uncomfortable short travels, lack of creative efforts
3.saturn: Extreme delays in initiatives, very poor sibling relationships, chronic problems with hands/shoulders, fears preventing action

4.general_effects: Affects mother, home, property, vehicles, education, and emotional foundation. Mother's health and domestic peace suffer
4.moon: Severe effects on mother's health and relationship, mental instability, loss of property, unhappy home life
4.mars: Conflicts at home, property disputes, vehicle accidents, problems with mother, fire hazard at home
4.mercury: Educational obstacles, problems in early schooling, vehicle troubles, poor relationship with maternal relatives
4.jupiter: Loss of family wealth, father-son conflicts affecting home, problems acquiring property, liver issues
4.venus: Marital discord affecting home peace, loss of comforts and vehicles, problems with mother, diabetes
4.saturn: Extreme unhappiness at home, chronic problems with mother, loss of property, severe depression, joint problems

5.general_effects: Affects children, intelligence, creativity, romance, speculation, and past-life merit. Problems with children and creative blocks
5.moon: Emotional problems affecting children, difficult pregnancies, poor intuitive intelligence, speculative losses
5.mars: Problems with sons, accidents to children, miscarriages, impulsive speculation leading to losses
5.mercury: Children's educational problems, poor decision-making in speculation, creative writing blocks, nervous children
5.jupiter: Serious problems with children (especially sons), loss of wisdom, bad luck, spiritual confusion, liver problems in children
5.venus: Problems in romance, love affairs causing trouble, daughters' problems, artistic blocks, reproductive issues
5.saturn: Severe delays in childbirth, chronic problems with children, depression, loss of joy, children with health issues

6.general_effects: Affects enemies, diseases, debts, litigation, service, and obstacles. Can give mixed results as combust planet in dusthana
6.moon: Digestive disorders, mental health issues from enemies, stress from litigation, maternal uncle's problems
6.mars: Victory over enemies but at cost, blood disorders, accidents during service, conflicts with subordinates
6.mercury: Skin diseases, nervous disorders from work stress, disputes in business, success through overcoming obstacles
6.jupiter: Liver problems, children's health issues, legal victories but at cost, recovery from diseases difficult
6.venus: Kidney problems, reproductive system diseases, conflicts with women, diabetes, marital problems from enemies
6.saturn: Chronic diseases, victory over enemies through patience, success in service despite delays, bone problems

7.general_effects: Affects marriage, partnerships, business relationships, and spouse. Marital problems and partnership conflicts common
7.moon: Emotionally distant marriage, mental problems in spouse, unhappy partnerships, public relationship problems
7.mars: Marital conflicts, aggressive spouse, business partnership disputes, accidents to spouse, surgeries in marriage life
7.mercury: Communication breakdown in marriage, business partnership problems, spouse with nervous issues, contractual disputes
7.jupiter: Spouse's ill health, lack of fortune through marriage, problems with partner's family, business losses through partners
7.venus: Severe marital discord, multiple relationships causing problems, spouse's health issues, luxury/comfort through marriage blocked
7.saturn: Delayed marriage, older spouse, chronic marital problems, separation, business partnership failures, spouse's longevity concerns

8.general_effects: Affects longevity, transformation, occult, inheritance, and sudden events. Can give occult powers but health problems
8.moon: Mental instability, psychic disturbances, inheritance problems from mother, sudden emotional upheavals
8.mars: Accidents, sudden injuries, violent transformations, sexual problems, conflicts over inheritance
8.mercury: Nervous breakdowns, occult knowledge but misused, sudden losses in business, problems with in-laws
8.jupiter: Chronic health issues, loss through inheritance, children's accidents, weak longevity indicators, spiritual crisis
8.venus: Sexual problems, diseases of reproductive organs, loss through spouse's family, sudden relationship endings
8.saturn: Can give occult powers and longevity, chronic diseases, inheritance delays, slow but deep transformations

9.general_effects: Affects father, fortune, dharma, higher learning, long travels, and spirituality. Father's health and fortune suffer
9.moon: Problems with father, foreign travels uncomfortable, weak fortune, mother-father conflicts, loss of faith
9.mars: Conflicts with father and teachers, aggressive religious views, accidents during long travels, brothers affecting fortune
9.mercury: Higher education obstacles, problems in foreign lands, poor relationship with gurus, philosophical confusion
9.jupiter: Father's serious health problems, loss of fortune and grace, spiritual confusion, problems with teachers, financial losses
9.venus: Marriage affecting relationship with father, loss of comforts during travels, artistic pursuits unrewarded, father-wife conflicts
9.saturn: Father's longevity concerns, chronic problems with fortune, extreme delays in spiritual progress, pessimistic philosophy

10.general_effects: Affects career, reputation, authority, public life, and achievements. Career obstacles and public image problems
10.moon: Unstable career, public image problems, difficulty in professions requiring emotional connection, mother affecting career
10.mars: Career conflicts, problems with authority, aggressive professional reputation, technical career blocks, litigation affecting status
10.mercury: Business and communication career problems, reputation for unreliability, intellectual work unrewarded, nervous in public life
10.jupiter: Career in teaching/counseling blocked, bad professional reputation, father's career affecting yours, loss of status
10.venus: Career in arts/luxury blocked, problems with women affecting career, marital issues affecting reputation, public charm reduced
10.saturn: Career delays and failures, chronic professional problems, bad reputation, problems with government, late success if any

11.general_effects: Affects gains, income, elder siblings, friends, aspirations, and social networks. Income problems and friendship issues
11.moon: Unstable income, problems with elder sister, lack of emotional fulfillment in friendships, aspirations unrealized
11.mars: Conflicts with friends and elder brothers, aggressive in social circles, losses through speculation, income through conflicts
11.mercury: Business income unstable, problems with networking, friends causing communication issues, elder siblings with health problems
11.jupiter: Major income losses, problems with elder children, unfulfilled aspirations, friends betraying, lack of support from network
11.venus: Losses through women friends, income from arts/luxury blocked, social life uncomfortable, elder sister's problems
11.saturn: Very limited income, chronic problems with elder siblings, isolation from social networks, delayed fulfillment of desires

12.general_effects: Affects losses, expenses, foreign lands, spirituality, isolation, and moksha. Can give spiritual benefits but material losses
12.moon: Emotional isolation, sleep problems, excessive expenses, problems in foreign lands, need for solitude
12.mars: Expenses through accidents/surgeries, hospital stays, losses through brothers, sexual problems, anger causing isolation
12.mercury: Mental isolation, nervous expenses on health, communication blocks leading to losses, problems abroad
12.jupiter: Major expenses on children, spiritual confusion, loss of wealth, problems in foreign settlements, weak moksha indicators
12.venus: Marital expenses and losses, problems with spouse in foreign lands, hospitalization for reproductive issues, artistic solitude
12.saturn: Can give spiritual depth and moksha, chronic health expenses, comfortable in isolation, foreign settlement delays but eventual success

retrograde_combustion.description: When a retrograde planet is combust, effects are more complex
retrograde_combustion.mercury: Mercury retrograde and combust within 3° can give unique analytical abilities but communication problems
retrograde_combustion.venus: Venus retrograde combust gives relationship karmas from past lives manifesting
retrograde_combustion.mars: Mars retrograde combust can give suppressed anger leading to explosions
retrograde_combustion.jupiter: Jupiter retrograde combust creates philosophical confusion but eventual wisdom
retrograde_combustion.saturn: Saturn retrograde combust intensifies karmic lessons and delays

own_sign_reduction.description: Planet combust in its own sign loses 50% less strength
examples: Moon combust in Cancer
Mars combust in Aries or Scorpio
Mercury combust in Gemini or Virgo
Jupiter combust in Sagittarius or Pisces
Venus combust in Taurus or Libra
Saturn combust in Capricorn or Aquarius
own_sign_reduction.note: Still counts as combustion but effects are significantly milder

exaltation_reduction.description: Planet combust in exaltation sign loses 60% less strength
examples: Moon combust in Taurus
Mars combust in Capricorn
Mercury combust in Virgo (also own sign)
Jupiter combust in Cancer
Venus combust in Pisces
Saturn combust in Libra
exaltation_reduction.note: Exaltation dignity provides strong protection against combustion

debilitation_amplification.description: Planet combust in debilitation is extremely weak (Neecha Bhanga possible only if very strong cancellations present)
examples: Moon combust in Scorpio - severe mental disturbance
Mars combust in Cancer - complete lack of courage
Mercury combust in Pisces - extreme confusion
Jupiter combust in Capricorn - total loss of wisdom
Venus combust in Virgo - relationship disasters
Saturn combust in Aries - extreme delays and frustrations
debilitation_amplification.note: This is one of the worst planetary conditions in a chart

budhaditya_yoga.description: Mercury within 3° of Sun creates Budhaditya Yoga - combustion but with benefits
budhaditya_yoga.positive_effects: Sharp intellect, good communication with authority, success in government, analytical brilliance
budhaditya_yoga.negative_effects: Nervous tension, communication under pressure, tendency to be critical
budhaditya_yoga.note: This is an exception where combustion can give positive results in specific domains

combust_with_retrograde.description: Retrograde planets require less degree to combust
combust_with_retrograde.others: Mars, Jupiter, Saturn use same combustion degrees whether retrograde or not

nakshatra_consideration.description: Planet combust in its own nakshatra gets some relief (10-15% strength)
examples: Moon in Rohini, Hasta, or Shravana
Mars in Mrigashira, Chitra, or Dhanishtha
Mercury in Ashlesha, Jyeshtha, or Revati
Jupiter in Punarvasu, Vishakha, or Purva Bhadrapada
Venus in Bharani, Purva Phalguni, or Purva Ashadha
Saturn in Pushya, Anuradha, or Uttara Bhadrapada

aspect_protection.description: Benefic aspects can reduce combustion effects
aspect_protection.malefic_aspects: Mars and Saturn aspects do not help, may worsen conditions

conjunction_effects.description: Other planets conjunct with combust planet
conjunction_effects.benefic_conjunction: Jupiter or Venus with combust planet provides some protection
conjunction_effects.malefic_conjunction: Mars or Saturn with combust planet worsens effects
conjunction_effects.multiple_combustion: Multiple planets combust together significantly weakens chart

house_lord_combustion.description: When house lord is combust, that house's significations suffer
house_lord_combustion.example: If 5th lord is combust anywhere in chart, children and intelligence suffer
house_lord_combustion.importance: Functional lordship matters more than natural significations sometimes

timing_of_effects.description: Combustion effects manifest most strongly during
timing_of_effects.dasha_periods: During combust planet's dasha or bhukti
timing_of_effects.transits: When Sun transits over natal combust planet position
timing_of_effects.solar_return: Year when Sun returns to exact combustion degree
timing_of_effects.progressed_combustion: When progressed Sun combusts natal planet
